name: Niv-Mizzet, Ghost Counsel
oracle_text:
Flying
Whenever you gain life, you may pay that much life. If you do, draw that many cards.
{T}: Each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
blocked_sentences: Whenever you gain life, you may pay that much life. If you do, draw that many cards.

needs.what: a `may` whose `pay` is `pay_life` priced by a value expression read in the resolving effect's context, so it can read the trigger's `{"binding": "amount"}` (the life just gained) and charge exactly that much life as a payment, with the `effects` (draw that many) running only if it was paid
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `may.pay` accepts a `pay_life` value expression, but `costs` evaluates it in a fresh EffectContext with no trigger bindings, so `{"binding": "amount"}` reads nothing and the payment would be 0 life for a free draw; `pay.times` scales only mana, not life; and a `may` wrapping `lose_life` is not a payment (it ignores can't-pay-life effects such as lock_life_total and the affordability check of 119.4)
